issues.title: Inside Kenya’s emerging violent extremism as 6 counties test Ruto’s govt security strategy
issues.title_en: Inside Kenya’s emerging violent extremism as 6 counties test Ruto’s govt security strategy
issues.summary: When President William Ruto’s administration promised to strengthen national security, the commitment was not simply to confront terrorists through police operations and intelligence gathering. It was also to address the conditions that make communities vulnerable to extremist recruitment. Four years after the 2022 election, however, a new government security report is raising a difficult question. […]
